name: Elemental de Aire

actions.name: Whirlwind
actions.effect: All creatures within 3m must pass PHYS save or be picked up and thrown 6m in a random direction, taking an additional 2d6 bludgeoning on landing and falling prone.

reactions.name: Gust Shield
reactions.effect: When targeted by a ranged attack, the elemental creates a gust. The attack has -2d6 to hit.

reactions.name: Zephyr Dodge
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack, the elemental flows around the strike. Reduces damage taken by 1d6.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.desc: Can move through spaces as narrow as 2cm. Can fly at double normal speed.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: Does not provoke reactions when flying out of an enemy's reach.

lore: Air Elementals appear as swirling vortexes of wind and cloud given malevolent purpose. They are the fastest of the elementals, striking like tornadoes and vanishing before retaliation.
